alternatives_rejected.why: The diskio z=5.8e12 in E1/E3 looks like a near-zero-variance baseline artifact. Real disk saturation would raise the service's own span self-time, but E2 shows it flat at 1.01->1.06ms while only caller-observed latency rose (3.8->204ms).

Frontend latency-50 rose about 6x (E1), far less than recommendationservice's 31-45x (E1). E2 shows callers see the added latency specifically on calls into recommendationservice, so frontend is a downstream symptom.

If a dependency of recommendationservice were slow, recommendationservice's own spans would show it. E2 shows its own self-time flat, so the delay sits at recommendationservice's inbound boundary. No productcatalogservice deviation appears in the all-services ranking (E1).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice's pod and network path for injected or added latency (e.g. a tc/netem qdisc, sidecar or network policy delay) and remove it. Confirm that caller-observed p50 returns to about 4ms. If it cannot be removed in place, roll the pod.
